answer: Divergent-History Attestation. Each agent identity must publish a signed history chain, and peers reject any two chains sharing an identical prefix beyond registration but diverging afterward, since true clones cannot fork their own past. Running a sybil cluster therefore forces the attacker to maintain distinct, non-overlapping histories per identity. The cost is continuous: a garden of parallel state trees, each requiring separate storage and validation work, with a velvet of duplicate signing overhead across every clone.
